maintenance_led.reason: Regulated water and wastewater utility billing customers for water service; revenue is service delivery, not repair or replacement of customer-owned items.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes from households and businesses paying water and wastewater bills under regulated rates, not from government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through rate-base investment in regulated utilities (San Jose Water, Connecticut Water, Maine Water, Texas); acquisitions like Cibolo Valley are occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Regulated monopoly water and wastewater utility; customers cannot switch, and water is essential and regulation-critical.
